fusions.name: Bell Clapper
fusions.desc: Swings a weighted herd-bell clapper at an enemy up to 4 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising 8% for each ally near you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Boiler Blast
fusions.desc: Opens a boiler valve across a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 13 damage to everything in it and knocks each enemy back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Barn Radiator
fusions.desc: Sets up a portable radiator that warms every ally within 5 tiles: they strike 15% harder and fight with 1 more power for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow-Burn Regulator
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
